The test image shows a mango leaf with whitish-gray powdery patches scattered across the upper surface, giving it a mottled, dusty appearance. The leaf is otherwise green with no necrotic browning or tip dieback. This pattern is classic for Powdery Mildew — a white/gray mealy coating on the leaf surface.

Now I'll view one reference image from Powdery_Mildew to confirm.

The Powdery_Mildew reference matches the test image almost exactly: same whitish-gray powdery patches scattered across a green mango leaf, same mottled dusty texture, no tip dieback, no sooty black coating, no dark necrotic lesions. The match is very strong.
